Build named server-side scope arguments for an analysis run

Source: R/analysis.R
dot-analysis_scope_expr.Rd

A single cohort reference travels as the literal named argument scope; multiple references travel as separate scalar scope_cohort_1, scope_cohort_2, ... arguments. Workspace omop.table symbols travel separately as bare-symbol named arguments scope_table_1, scope_table_2, and so on. No nested list() or c() expression is emitted: allowing those generic AggregateMethods would let a caller evaluate an unreviewed container around protected objects.

Usage

.analysis_scope_expr(cohort = NULL, tables = NULL)

Arguments

cohort

Cohort reference (a dsomop_cohort_handle, a cohort_definition_id, or a server-side table name) or NULL.

tables

Character vector of server-side omop.table symbol names, or NULL.

Value

NULL or a named local list of call arguments. Its values are cohort literals and/or bare table symbols; it never contains a call.

Details

Forms produced:

  • no cohort, no tables -> NULL (no scoping argument).

  • one cohort -> list(scope = <literal>); multiple cohorts -> sequential scalar scope_cohort_<n> arguments.

  • table symbol(s) -> a named list whose values are bare symbols and whose names are the sequential scope_table_<n> arguments.
